key_points: Gilead expanded royalty‑free voluntary licensing for lenacapavir to include an investigational once‑yearly formulation for HIV PrEP in 120 high‑incidence, lower‑income countries.
Company raised its 2026 sales outlook, signaling confidence in continued growth.
Quarterly dividend increased by 3.8%, returning cash to shareholders.
HIV franchise sales remain strong, driving double‑digit growth, though reported earnings were weaker than expected.
Overall fundamentals appear improving, supporting a bullish near‑to‑medium term view.
